introduced: F4, which rebuilt a lit Nether portal next to the player - the only content this build adds beyond Alpha v1.2.0. Read from the client: Minecraft.java handles key code 62 by calling nj.c(world, player), which searches 16 blocks around the player for a floor with headroom, takes an orientation from nextInt(4) and places an obsidian frame with lit portal blocks inside. It does not teleport: nj.b, which finds an existing portal within 128 blocks and moves the player to it, is not called.
